name: OnScreenKeyboard
description:
An on-screen keyboard for kiosks, TVs driven by a remote's arrow keys, touch screens where
the native keyboard is unsuitable, and search panels (the alphabet grid).

Standalone it owns a text value (controlled or uncontrolled); with `target` it types into
an input, textarea or contenteditable element at its caret, firing `input` events so
React-controlled inputs update, without taking focus from it. Layouts are data
({@link KeyboardLayout}): built-in layouts cover the major scripts, including Hangul
syllable composition and kana marks; the globe key cycles `layouts`.

Keyboard: one tab stop; arrow keys move by the keys' positions on screen (so wide keys and
right-to-left layouts behave as they look); Home and End go to the row's ends; Enter or
Space presses the focused key; holding Enter, or holding a key with the pointer, offers
accented alternates; physical typing edits the text while focus is on the keyboard;
Escape calls `onEscape`. Layer, layout and Caps Lock changes are announced politely.
signature: ({ layout: layoutProp, layouts, onLayoutChange, value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, target, onKeyPress, onEnter, enterKind: enterKindProp, size, variant: variantProp, captureTyping, wrap, onNavigateOut, onEscape, onHide, autoFocus, disabled, showAlternates, locale: localeProp, className, style, "aria-describedby": describedBy, ref, ...rest }: OnScreenKeyboardProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the first key on mount (TV interfaces).

props.name: captureTyping
props.description: Physical keys typed while focus is on the keyboard edit the text or target. Default true.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial text when uncontrolled and without a target. Default "".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Every key is disabled.

props.name: enterKind
props.description: The Enter key's label and colour. Default: the target's `enterkeyhint`, else "enter".

props.name: layout
props.description: The layout shown: a layout or a built-in identifier. Default: the first of `layouts`, else the locale's layout (`layoutForLocale`). A new value replaces the shown layout.

props.name: layouts
props.description: The layouts the globe key cycles through. Omit, or give one, for no globe key.

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the locale for the default layout, `decimal` and `alphabet`.

props.name: onEnter
props.description:
Called when Enter is pressed. Unless prevented, an input target gets an Enter keydown
and then its form is submitted (requestSubmit); a textarea or contenteditable target
gets a new line.

props.name: onEscape
props.description: Called when Escape is pressed on the keyboard.

props.name: onHide
props.description:
Shows a hide key and is called when it is pressed. Typing layouts put it on the bottom
row; a grid layout (a number pad) puts it in a blank cell, and shows none without one.

props.name: onKeyPress
props.description: Called for every press, before the keyboard acts; `details.preventDefault()` skips the action.

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Called with the layout the globe key moved to.

props.name: onNavigateOut
props.description: Called when an arrow key is pressed at the keyboard's edge, with the screen direction: move focus to the results beside it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new text after each edit when the keyboard owns the text (no `target`).

props.name: showAlternates
props.description: Press and hold (500 ms, or a held Enter) offers accented alternates. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Key size: sm for narrow panels, md (default) about a control's height, lg for TVs viewed from across a room.

props.name: target
props.description:
An input, textarea or contenteditable element to type into, or a ref to one. The
keyboard edits it at its caret and fires `input` events, so React-controlled inputs
update. Pointer presses never take focus from it.

props.name: value
props.description: The text, when the keyboard owns it (no `target`). Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description: keys: separate keycaps (the default for typing layouts); grid: flat tiles (the default for grid layouts: the alphabet, number pads).

props.name: wrap
props.description: Arrow keys continue from the far side at an edge, instead of calling `onNavigateOut`. Default false.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
